full_judgment: 3. It appears that on 4-11-2000 one Md. Kechua Mamud lodged a First Information Report with Nilphamari police station against 8 (eight) accused persons specifically mentioned therein stating inter alia that on 20-10-2000 at about 12 noon the accused formed themselves into unlawful assembly and assaulted the informant and other witnesses and also took away Taka 1200.00 from the possession of Shahabuddin. On the basis of the said First Information Report Nilphamari PS Case No. 4 dated 4-11-2000 under sections 143/323/324/379 of the Penal Code was started against the said 8(Eight) accused persons specifically mentioned in the First Information Report, The name of the aforesaid Labu was not mentioned as an accused.
